title: Online counter: schema migration + heartbeat + frontend integration

context_files.reason: Pure functions, dependency injection for heartbeat

acceptance_criteria: Schema: `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ` via supabase_apply_migration
Heartbeat: on ForumPage mount (and every 60s interval), authenticated users update their `last_seen_at = now()` in users table
Heartbeat: only for authenticated users (skip if not logged in)
Online count: `random(3000, 10000) + COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE last_seen_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'`
New service function `getOnlineCount()` returns computed online count
ForumPage: `onlineCount` updated via getOnlineCount() on mount + 30s refresh interval
ForumPage: removes hardcoded `const seed = Math.floor(Date.now() / 60000)` fake online count logic
RLS: users can only update their own last_seen_at
deliverables: Supabase migration: add last_seen_at to users
Updated src/pages/ForumPage.tsx (heartbeat interval, online count from DB)
